Overall: ship-with-fixes. Three MEDIUM findings, all actioned in this same diff:
1. [bug, MEDIUM, TerminalSettingsCard.tsx] Checkbox seeded from isGpuAccelerationEnabled(), which resolved the EFFECTIVE renderer incl. the ?terminalRenderer= query param. With ?terminalRenderer=webgl and nothing stored the box showed checked; un-checking it showed unchecked while the query kept WebGL alive on the next mount - the control lying about what it controls. FIXED: isGpuAccelerationEnabled() now reads localStorage ONLY; new isRendererOverriddenByQuery() drives an explicit note in the card when a query override is active. Regression tests added (terminal-renderer.test.ts, 2 cases).
2. [spec, MEDIUM, e2e 93] AC-3 required an E2E through the real Settings UI; the existing arms seeded localStorage directly and never visited Settings. FIXED: new test "the Settings checkbox persists the choice and a new terminal mounts with it" - opens /settings, asserts default-unchecked, checks it, asserts persistence, mounts a terminal and asserts renderer=webgl, then un-checks and asserts renderer=dom. PASS in real chromium.
